description: Send one signed webhook.test event to the configured endpoint now and report the HTTP status and latency. Not retried; at most 5 per minute. Set the endpoint first with everyinfra_webhook_set (otherwise not_found). Returns object account_webhook.test with delivered, event_id and last_attempt (status_code, latency_ms, error). Takes no arguments: {}. Needs the settings:write account scope, which is off by default and can only be granted by the account owner in the console.
name: everyinfra_webhook_test
title: Send a test webhook
